upgrades.effect: Opens "Did you experience any side effects?" (seen live, runs/verify-beard-minox-se-yes screen 08).
Opens a required free-text box about the side effects; no warning and no stop, the flow carries on to the allergy question (seen live, runs/verify-beard-minox-se-yes screens 09 to 11).

No effect on the flow: answering No (not willing to proceed) goes straight to the account form, exactly like Yes. No stop, no message (seen live, runs/verify-beard-psoriasis-no screen 12, same 10 screens as runs/exp-41). What the prescriber does with a No is unknown.
upgrades.note: beard-q12 "No" (not willing to proceed despite the psoriasis warning) was labelled code and typed flag-for-clinician. A live replay (runs/verify-beard-psoriasis-no) shows it goes straight to the account form like Yes; now observed, effect none on the flow.

upgrades.effect: Dead end (seen live, runs/exp-42 and runs/verify-beard-female): the screen stays on the gender question with no notice. Pressing the Continue button that is still on screen shows an unrelated error, "Your email address appears to be from an invalid domain name. Please check for typos and try again", and still does not move on (runs/verify-beard-female-continue screen 05). No signposting to a GP or specialist.
upgrades.note: beard-q2 "Female" was described as a silent dead end with no message. Pressing the Continue button still on screen shows an unrelated email-domain error (runs/verify-beard-female-continue screen 05). Wording corrected in the option and in R41.
